svg.title: Merge sort on eight lines: sorted runs of 1, 2, 4 and 8, each merged from two of the row above

g.title: The eight lines as read: each line alone is a sorted run of one.
merge v[0..1) and v[1..2) into v[0..2): 1 comparison, 1 in all.
merge v[2..3) and v[3..4) into v[2..4): 1 comparison, 2 in all.
merge v[0..2) and v[2..4) into v[0..4): 2 comparisons, 4 in all (one side ran out first, so the rest of the other is copied without comparing).
merge v[4..5) and v[5..6) into v[4..6): 1 comparison, 5 in all.
merge v[6..7) and v[7..8) into v[6..8): 1 comparison, 6 in all.
merge v[4..6) and v[6..8) into v[4..8): 2 comparisons, 8 in all (one side ran out first, so the rest of the other is copied without comparing).
merge v[0..4) and v[4..8) into v[0..8): 7 comparisons, 15 in all.
